what_i_see: A thin streak about 7 arcsec long with an orange central bulge and bluer, fainter ends; the eastern end bends gently southward. Nothing bright lies near it on either side.
most_likely: An edge-on disc galaxy with a warped or tidally bent outer disc, at photo-z about 0.46.
against_it: The curvature gives it an arc-like look, but there is no candidate lensing galaxy and the red-centre, blue-ends pattern is that of a disc.
decisive_test: A spectrum along the major axis showing a rotation curve would confirm an edge-on disc.
catalogue_notes: Legacy photo-z 0.46±0.18 at 0.84 arcsec (extended). SIMBAD: nothing within 60; NED nearest WISEA source 24.8. Gaia none within 16. Four lens lists: no match within 60. Huang+2020 query errored first, then returned empty twice.
